This update for git-bug fixes the following issues:

Changes in git-bug:

- CVE-2026-1229: CIRCL had an incorrect calculation in
  secp384r1 CombinedMult (bsc#1265416, GO-2026-4550):
  updated github.com/cloudflare/circl to v1.6.3
- CVE-2026-41506: HTTP authentication credential leak when
  following redirects during smart-HTTP clone and fetch
  operations (bsc#1264955, GO-2026-4910):
  updated github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 to v5.17.1
